verdict.rationale: Raygun documents mute/ignore controls for error groups: ignore for a set time period, ignore for a number of occurrences, or ignore by rule. Error grouping also consolidates repeat crashes, and alerting runs through rules that can create PagerDuty incidents. There is no evidence of spike protection or per-key rate limiting, so only part of the noise-reduction story is covered. Missing for 10: spike protection, per-key/per-application rate limits, alert throttling or deduplication specific to notifications, and independent hands-on corroboration.
